description:
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Fatestitcher's unearth ability by paying {U}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste until end of turn.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fatestitcher.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
